# heraut init

Generate .heraut.yml interactively (or with --defaults).

Create .heraut.yml by answering a few questions: versioning strategy, tag prefix, changelog and where
to publish. With an existing file it offers to update it. --defaults writes a default config without
asking: SemVer, prefix v, CHANGELOG.md, and a release on the forge found from CI or the git origin.

## Usage

```text
heraut init [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut init
heraut init --defaults
heraut init --config .config/heraut.yml
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--defaults` |  | write opinionated defaults non-interactively |
| `--overwrite` |  | overwrite an existing config file without prompting |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
